title: Firefox private browsing must be disabled.
check_content:
Type "about:policies" in the browser window. 

If "DisablePrivateBrowsing" is not displayed under Policy Name or the Policy Value is not "true", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Windows group policy:
1. Open the group policy editor tool with "gpedit.msc".
2. Navigate to Policy Path: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Mozilla\Firefox
Policy Name: Disable Private Browsing
Policy State: Enabled

macOS "plist" file:
Add the following:
<key>DisablePrivateBrowsing</key>
<true/>

Linux "policies.json" file:
Add the following in the policies section:
"DisablePrivateBrowsing": true
VulnDiscussion: Private browsing allows the user to browse the internet without recording their browsing history/activity. From a forensics perspective, this is unacceptable. Best practice requires that browser history is retained.
